messages:
maria g: pushed a small Next.js + LangChain starter to examples repo. goal: quickstart to embed + rerank using Redwood embeddings + completions. PR: https://github.com/redwood/examples/pull/512 :rocket:
kevin: nice, linking it in the docs would help. quick q — are we using the new SDK auth flow or the legacy header? :eyes:
sam: saw the PR, tried the app locally. running into repeated completions — looks like retries cause duplicate messages in the convo state. reproducible with rapid-fire requests.
maria g: hm — I'm instantiating the SDK like `new Redwood({ apiKey: process.env.REDWOOD_API_KEY })` in `lib/redwood.js`
olivia: FYI we renamed env var to `REDWOOD_API_KEY` in env docs last month. but some samples still use `REDWOOD_KEY` — could be onboarding friction.
kevin: the retry + conversation duplicate problem might be because the sample doesn't set idempotency keys for the chat route. we should recommend `Idempotency-Key` header for client-side retries, or surface a helper in the SDK.
sam: exact repro steps I used:
```
1) yarn dev
2) open two tabs hitting /api/chat with same prompt quickly
3) see two completions appended to conversation in UI
```
request logs show status 200 twice, but from UX perspective it's a duplicate.
maria g: oof, thanks. sample uses fetch wrapper without retries. but Next.js dev overlay sometimes resends? also our SDK has an internal retry in node env for 500s unless you pass `maxRetries: 0`.
kevin: SDK parity note: browser SDK currently doesn't expose `maxRetries` option — only Node does. that's causing people to rely on fetch-level retry libs and forget idempotency.
olivia: can we add a short note in the starter README: "set REDWOOD_API_KEY, ensure idempotency for retries, or set maxRetries to 0". also a tiny util to generate idempotency keys in the example would be helpful.
sam: suggestion: set `Idempotency-Key: prompt_hash` computed from prompt+sessionId. small code snippet:
```js
const key = sha256(prompt + sessionId);
fetch('/api/chat', { headers: { 'Idempotency-Key': key } })
```
maria g: I'll add that. also will add a comment about env var names to avoid onboarding friction.
kevin: on the SDK side, we should add parity: browser SDK expose `maxRetries` and allow custom `idempotencyKey` generation hook.
maria g: created issue: https://github.com/redwood/examples/issues/77 — description + repro + proposed fix :bug:
devex-bot: CI passed for branch maria/next-langchain-starter (build 8472)
olivia: small UX ask — could we include a dev proxy route that injects the API key on server side so people don't need to set env locally? `pages/api/proxy-chat.js` that forwards to Redwood API with server-side auth.
sam: that would also avoid leaking keys in the browser and reduce mistaken configs from copy/paste.
maria g: adding proxy option as an alternate pattern in README. plan: update README + add idempotency util + patch sample to set `maxRetries: 0` for browser init and a note to enable server-side proxied calls for production.
kevin: can we also add a tiny test (Playwright) that hits chat endpoint twice and asserts no duplicate messages? would prevent regressions.
maria g: yes, adding a single e2e test in `examples/nextjs/tests/chat-duplicates.spec.ts`.
sam: thanks everyone — will rerun my local after PR update and report back.
maria g: thanks, pushing changes in 10-15m :thumbsup:
